reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

- **Where it comes from:** During the outage on 2025-09-03, Pree posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that it was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see all of this himself.
- **A second account of the outage:** The Central team's weekly update for 9/8 names Little Rock and Shreveport, not Southgate. Those were the hubs where clerks had to enter trailer arrivals by hand (ticket INC-44912), which was about gate check-in rather than label printing. I told Tobias about it so he isn't caught out on the customer call. He's on the Central team, so he can see that update too.

The reply has no prices or contract amounts, and nothing from anyone's direct messages or private notes.
